list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(observability): enable full OTLP pipeline for logs, traces and metrics
Fix the broken observability stack so the three signals reach Grafana through the OTel Collector.
Infra: - otel-collector: route logs pipeline to Loki via otlphttp exporter (previously logs only went to the debug exporter and were dropped) - loki: upgrade to 3.x and switch schema to tsdb/v13 with native OTLP ingestion and structured metadata support - tempo: configure metrics_generator (service-graphs + span-metrics) with remote_write to Prometheus; remove unsupported ingester and traces_storage fields - prometheus: enable --web.enable-remote-write-receiver and exemplar storage for Tempo metrics and trace/metric correlation - grafana: fix Loki derived field (trace_id via structured metadata) and wire Tempo serviceMap/tracesToMetrics to Prometheus
App (BuildingBlocks.Logging): - bridge ILogger<T> to Serilog via AddSerilog() so application logs are exported through OTLP to Loki - filter /metrics, /health and /swagger from AspNetCore tracing to surface real POST/PUT spans in Tempo - set service.namespace on the OTel resource for consistent metadata - remove dead code (unused Loki HTTP sink, manual ActivityEnricher)

task.summary: New features are being added to the demo project: business logic, new endpoints, DevOps, and more.

New features are being added to the demo project: business logic, new endpoints, DevOps, and more.
Expanding the functions of the Mini Deploy Framework

refactor(infra): unify service connection model + fix healthchecks + docker/host consistency
* Introduced unified connection contract across all services:
* internal_host (docker network) * external_host (host machine) * connection.* as single source of truth
* Implemented resolve_host() to correctly route traffic depending on runtime context
* Fixed Vault integration:
* Vault now consistently uses internal_host * Avoids localhost misrouting inside containers
* Refactored orchestrator and waiters:
* Removed ambiguity between host/docker_host * Standardized access to connection config
* Fixed healthcheck system:
* Updated Postgres and RabbitMQ checkers to use connection.* * Added authentication support for RabbitMQ management API * Improved logging and error visibility
* Eliminated multiple KeyError issues caused by inconsistent schema
Result: ✔ Full infra bootstrap stable ✔ Vault + Postgres + RabbitMQ working end-to-end ✔ Healthchecks deterministic and consistent ✔ Docker vs localhost conflict fully resolved
fix(config): enforce worker command definition in services model
feat(orchestrator): integrate Vault bootstrap lifecycle after infra readiness
